name: drift-gradient
title: Drift gradient
description: Soft pools of blue and cyan drift like defocused light through water. It loops with no join.

props.name: mid
props.doc: The body of the field (electric blue).

props.name: light
props.doc: The lighter field around the bright pools (sky blue).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size of the pools: higher is larger.

props.name: contrast
props.doc: How dark the dark pools and how bright the bright ones get.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Loops per 10 seconds. Whole numbers loop seamlessly.
